aux_approval.description: Auxiliary LLM calls that decide whether a proposed tool use is approved — measured fleet-wide as the dominant auxiliary cost contributor (95.83% of auxiliary cost on the sizing sample), not an afterthought to the other five labels
examples: should this tool call be allowed to run
evaluate this pending action against policy

aux_title_generation.description: Auxiliary LLM calls that generate a short session or conversation title
examples: generate a title for this session
summarize this conversation in a few words

aux_compression.description: Auxiliary LLM calls that compress or summarize prior context to free up window space
examples: summarize the earlier turns to save context

aux_vision.description: Auxiliary LLM calls that process image or visual input
examples: describe what is in this screenshot

aux_web_extract.description: Auxiliary LLM calls that extract structured content from fetched web pages
examples: pull the relevant section out of this page
extract the article body from this HTML

aux_session_search.description: Auxiliary LLM calls that search across prior sessions or history
examples: find the earlier session where this was discussed
search past conversations for this topic
